messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to enable the new prefetch + micro-batching feature flag on staging tomorrow 10:00 PST. rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30m between stages). Need quick checkers for perf and DB load, and a clear rollback path. @aditya @nina can you confirm availability?

aditya: I can watch the p95/p50 and request rate during the 10% canary. will run a controlled spike job and watch GPU util + redis latency. suggest alert thresholds: p95 > 220ms OR errors > 1% => pause.

nina: I can run db/redis tail and check hot keys. also will verify KV cache hit rate and mem pressure. I'll post graphs to the thread during checks.

leah: quick question — are we enabling prefix caching too or only micro-batch? need to know for eviction patterns.

maria: good catch. staging toggle enables both prefetch (prefix cache) and micro-batch path. we have a tag to turn prefetch off independently if needed.

james-oncall: will be on call for the rollout window. add me to pager for any spike. what's the rollback play?

aditya: rollback steps (short):
1) flip feature flag "ff_prefetch_microbatch" -> off (console or ff service)
2) scale down new batch workers: kubectl -n inference scale deployment batch-worker-new --replicas=0
3) clear temp cache if necessary: redis-cli -h redis-stage DEL prefetch:* (only if we see corruption)
4) confirm traffic falls back to old path and latency stabilizes
if UI/alerts trigger, flip flag first then scale.

deploy-bot: Canary started: audience=10% (segment: staging-canary-2026-03), version=canary-v2, initiated-by=maria

aditya: smoke job command I will run:
```
loadtest --target https://staging.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 60 --rps 300 --duration 5m --headers "Authorization: Bearer $STAGE_KEY"
```
I'll share prometheus query snippets: p95 tokens latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[2m])) by (le))`

nina: grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/staging-inference (will paste panels: p95, errors, redis ops, gpu_util)

leah: small ops ask — can we block the 50% step until both perf + mem are green for 10m? want a manual gate.

maria: yes manual gate at 50% — I'll wait for checks+thumbs. schedule: 10:00 start -> 10:30 gate decision -> 11:00 maybe finish.

james-oncall: if any of these happen, escalate immediately: sustained error rate >1% for 5m, p95 climb >50% over baseline, or redis evictions > 100/s. I'll page SRE and infra.

aditya: noted. I'll be posting a short readiness checklist before we flip: 
- smoke traffic run complete
- p50/p95 within thresholds
- redis hit rate >= expected
- no backend 5xx spike
- infra logs clean (no OOMs)
I'll drop timestamps and a final thumbs emoji.

maria: thanks all. tagging this thread for the rollout window and I'll update with the actual gate decision. :thumbsup:
